notes:
September 11th 2026
Version 13.10+ (stable) / 13.11+ (beta)
**********************
NEW!
* Re-synchronized several data issues. (K,R)
* New audio editor for backing tracks - trim, fade, level and tone (EQ). (K,R)
* Zoom the tree text with Cmd/Ctrl + and - (Cmd/Ctrl 0 resets); every tree in the window follows. (K) (R)
* Live Editor changes now reach your accordion in real-time - the "Send to Accordion" button has been removed. (R)
* Write/Save shows a * while the accordion is playing changes you have not saved yet. (R)
* Live Editor: an Undo button takes back your last change - the accordion follows. (R)
* Chin switches, Master Bar and Effect Pot now take effect as you set them. (R)
* Press Ctrl+R any time to ask a question or report an issue. (K,R)
* See Help->Show Release Notes for More...
notes_beta:
September 16th 2026 (evening)
Version 13.11.25+ (beta)
**********************
NEW!
* If your internet connection cannot reach the K-Configurator servers over IPv6 (a known problem on some providers), the program now retries over IPv4 by itself - no more licence heartbeat failures or 30-second "Connection Problem" waits from that cause. (K,R)
* The main window now fits small and high-resolution laptop screens (Surface, 1366x768) instead of being cut off at the bottom. (K,R)
* If K-Configurator's expansion-pack settings differ from what your accordion has loaded, it now offers to correct them as soon as it knows - including after a read made in the Live Editor - instead of silently leaving the wrong "[Not Installed]" markers. (R)
* Shared Repository: a first slow connection is retried quietly before the "Connection Problem" message appears. (R)
* See Help->Show Release Notes for More...
